scope: One full million-event synthetic fixture; no new three-scale benchmark, no historical truncation or sampling.

root_cause.detail: Session and exercise detail queries scanned all 100001 user sets or all 100001 session exercises. The click invokes one render that writes a draft and another render after st.rerun, repeating these scans.
root_cause.profile_interpretation: Each strength render spent roughly 1.1 seconds in three detail SQL shapes. SQL 'calls' counts timed execute/fetch/iteration operations, not distinct query executions. Profiling overhead is excluded from all latency budget decisions.
